name: Mitchell Nortje
bio: Mitchell was born in South Africa and moved to the UK at 23, bringing a couple of years of teaching programming with him. Since then he's worked across digital agencies building sites in Sitefinity, WordPress, nopCommerce and Umbraco, plus some time in product development. Umbraco is the CMS he actually stuck with, and he's genuinely fond of the community around it. Outside of work he takes photos, plays D&D, sews (badly, by his own admission), goes on long walks, and is training to become a counsellor, which he insists is unrelated to how many hours he's spent debugging other people's code.
